description:
An ER romance between resident Da-Jeong and hospital CEO Tae-Kyung! 

Da-Jeong, a pediatrician, spends an impulsive one-night stand with Tae-Kyung, the newly appointed CEO of the hospital foundation. 

*“I’m sorry, CEO. Please just forget about it—”

“I don’t think that’s going to work. I have an absolutely phenomenal memory.”*

Tae-Kyung, nicknamed “The Bloodthirsty Butcher” for his foul temper and brutality, takes office as the new CEO, and the department, already struggling with deficits, feels threatened. Da-Jeong, who works in the Pediatrics Department, one of the hospital’s three deficit-ridden departments, is both afraid of Tae-Kyung and can’t stop thinking about him. CEO Tae-Kyung clearly came to shut down the Pediatrics Department, so why is Da-Jeong falling for him so helplessly?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
